stone-gray.note: AA note: fails contrast for text on cream (2.93:1) — use stone-ink #6B665F for text on light surfaces.

terracotta-ink.note: Text-grade terracotta for light surfaces. #CB5C38 reads 3.57:1 on Atelier Cream (AA failure); #A0421F reads 5.56:1. Use for eyebrows, labels, and text links on cream/sand; keep #CB5C38 for rules, focus rings, hovers, and dark surfaces.

stone-ink.note: Text-grade stone for light surfaces. #8C8C8C reads 2.93:1 on Atelier Cream (AA failure); #6B665F reads 4.96:1. Use for content-bearing labels and captions on cream/sand; keep #8C8C8C for hairlines and dark surfaces (5.89:1 on Atelier Black).

display.purpose: Page heroes and section openers. One per viewport. Carries -0.04em optical left margin.

headline.purpose: Product names, article titles, modal headings.

body.purpose: Editorial copy in Playfair at 1.8 line-height, capped at 65-75ch.

label.purpose: The whisper: 10px Montserrat, 0.2-0.4em tracking, uppercase. Eyebrows, buttons, nav, metadata.

shadows.name: print-lift
shadows.purpose: Lookbook and product imagery at rest. Never on chrome.

motion.name: ease-cinematic
motion.purpose: Default reveal and transition easing (ease-out-expo family).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-filled commerce action; floods terracotta on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1C1C1C; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 16px 32px; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #CB5C38; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #CB5C38; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #1C1C1C; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.25em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 14px 32px; border: 1px solid rgba(28,28,28,0.3); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #1C1C1C; color: #FFFFFF; border-color: transparent; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #CB5C38; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 280px; background: transparent; } .ds-card-img { aspect-ratio: 3/4; background: #E5E2DC; box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); margin-bottom: 24px; } .ds-card-meta { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #CB5C38; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 400; color: #1C1C1C; margin: 0; } .ds-card-price { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 18px; color: #1C1C1C; }

components.name: Floating Input
components.description: Borderless field with bottom hairline and tracked floating label.
components.css: .ds-field { position: relative; width: 280px; padding-top: 18px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(28,28,28,0.2); padding: 8px 0; font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 16px; color: #1C1C1C; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: #1C1C1C; } .ds-label { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 26px; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8C8C8C; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); pointer-events: none; } .ds-input:focus + .ds-label, .ds-input:not(:placeholder-shown) + .ds-label { top: 0; font-size: 9px; color: #CB5C38; }

narrative.overview: An Italian workshop shot like a film. Warm paper-cream surfaces stand in for the cutting table; photography carries the drama; type behaves like a title sequence — enormous, patient Playfair Display serifs over whispering tracked-uppercase labels. Pacing is part of the design: long scroll distances, slow reveals, generous negative space between acts. The system is quiet by default so that scale and imagery can be loud. The house intends to push bolder and more fashion-forward than a typical quiet-luxury site: editorial asymmetry, oversized headlines, and confident full-bleed photography are encouraged.
keyCharacteristics: Cream-paper canvas, ink-dark text, a single terracotta flame used sparingly
Serif-led: even body copy speaks Playfair; Montserrat exists only for tracked uppercase labels
Square geometry everywhere; circles only for dots, badges, and the logo mark
Flat chrome, cinematic shadows under imagery only
Choreographed motion: slow ease-out reveals (700-1400ms), never bouncy

rules.name: The One Flame Rule
rules.body: Terracotta appears on at most ~10% of any screen — an eyebrow, a rule line, a focus ring, one hover. Its rarity is its authority.

rules.name: The Warm Dark Rule
rules.body: Dark surfaces are Atelier Black (#0A0A0A) or Ink Charcoal — never pure black, never cool gray.

rules.name: The Whisper-and-Shout Rule
rules.body: Type is either enormous Playfair or tiny tracked Montserrat. The middle register (16-24px sans) is forbidden in brand surfaces.

rules.name: The Italic Aside Rule
rules.body: Playfair italic is reserved for human asides, never for emphasis inside running copy.

rules.name: The Lifted Print Rule
rules.body: If it isn't a photograph or a modal, it doesn't cast a shadow.

dos: Do open every page with the eyebrow → Playfair display → hairline sequence; one display headline per viewport.
Do let photography go full-bleed and asymmetric; editorial spreads beat centered stacks.
Do use square corners and 1px hairlines everywhere in chrome; reserve circles for dots and badges.
Do keep motion at 700-1400ms with ease-out-expo curves, and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do push scale contrast further when in doubt — this house wants bolder, not safer.
donts: Don't ship generic Shopify-luxe template sameness: centered hero + 3-col card grid + testimonial strip is prohibited composition.
Don't import loud streetwear hype: no countdowns, no neon, no all-caps body copy, no drop mechanics.
Don't drift into cold sterile minimalism: surfaces stay warm cream, never clinical white outside lightboxes.
Don't lapse into old-money clutter: no ornamental borders, no gold foil, no script faces.
Don't set Stone Gray (#8C8C8C) on cream below 14px — it fails AA; darken it instead.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, colored side-stripes, or shadows on chrome (The Lifted Print Rule).
